item_name: Rothco U.S.N. Heavyweight Canvas Sea Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s U.S.N. Heavyweight Canvas Sea Bag is the ultimate travel and storage companion. Made from rugged heavyweight canvas, this vertical sea bag resists wear and tear, making it ideal for long-term use. The pull cord closure, reinforced with brass eyelets, ensures secure storage, whether you’re carrying laundry, sports gear, or personal belongings. Its oversized design, measuring 26 inch x 36 inch, offers ample space for a variety of uses, including travel or workouts.
